name: Blue Shift

frame.name: High-Impact Frame
frame.description: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.description:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

flavor: What is the color of the universe?
